source.name: Deutsches Institut fuer Marketing, Trikotsponsoren der Bundesliga (stand 4 Aug 2026)
source.quote: Lexware ist neuer Haupt- und Trikotsponsor des SC Freiburg.

summary: Lexware (front) is the only shirt sponsor of the 2026/27 home kit; no sleeve, back or shorts sponsor is listed. Lexware belongs to the family-owned Haufe Group SE of Freiburg.
